info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Quality Assurance Assessments API
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance Assessments API facilitates the evaluation and assurance of product quality within the banking sector. This API enables users to initiate assessments aimed at ensuring compliance with quality standards. It supports various stakeholders, including product managers and quality assurance teams, who utilize the assessments to enhance product reliability and customer satisfaction. By leveraging this API, organizations can systematically manage their product evaluation processes and make informed decisions based on quality metrics.

post.summary: Create a product quality assurance assessment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an assessment for product quality assurance, ensuring that products meet predefined quality standards. The assessment includes various criteria that are important for product evaluation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit product quality assurance assessments. It should contain the assessment details structured according to the specified schema.

200.description: The assessment was successfully processed and results are returned.
